name: pixel-image
blurb: Image animates as pixelated grid fading in with color reveal.
description: Renders an image as a pixelated grid with staggered fade-in animation. Pixels appear in grayscale then reveal color, with configurable preset (6x4, 8x8, etc.) or custom grid sizes.
use_when: Hero sections, loading sequences, or artistic galleries showcasing images with unique pixelation reveal effects.
avoid_when: When image details must be visible immediately; animation delay obscures content during the reveal phase.
a11y: Image element with alt text support; decorative animations are non-essential and don't interfere with content.
